sourceContract: Codex CLI rollout JSONL ($CODEX_HOME/sessions/YYYY/MM/DD/rollout-*-<session-id>.jsonl) written by a real `codex exec` run, one record per array entry: session_meta, turn_context, response_item, token_usage_record, and event_msg token_count / task_started / task_complete
author: otel-hook rollout-usage owner (agent)
sanitization: Captured from Codex 0.163.0 driven by the agent lab's scripted Responses mock (no real model, no real prompt): every token counter is the mock's frozen scenario value. Paths rebased onto a fictional /workspace tree; every string longer than 40 characters that is not an id, type or model (instructions, prompts, tool arguments and output, the synthetic widget contents) replaced by <omitted>; the world_state payload dropped. No credentials, hostnames or personal data.
licenseBasis: Field names and record layout reproduce a third-party tool's on-disk format; every value is either this repository's own mock scenario or a placeholder.
notes: One turn, two model requests (a tool call, then the final answer). token_count.info.total_token_usage and token_usage_record.thread_token_usage carry the thread's running total, cache_write_input_tokens included; Stop carries no usage. Exercised by tests/providers/codex/rollout-usage-enricher.test.ts.
